details:
If you're doing any kind of video work with the camera lens it's important the audio makes sense spatially.
For example, if you're filming an interview and have to record yourself while appearing on screen, it makes it weird for the viewer to hear the voices come from the "wrong" direction.
If you could temporarily switch  your audio listener to your lens, it would help a lot, despite it possibly being bit confusing for the person recording. Maybe a ear icon would appear on the lens nameplate?
title: Audio listener for VRC camera lens
